Dear Kiran,

Happy birthday to my best friend — my favourite person to laugh with, to share everything with, and to simply have by my side.

I don't say this often enough, so let me write it down properly: thank you. Thank you for listening to the same stories twice, for understanding my silences, for celebrating my small wins like they were your own, and for standing by me in the moments that actually mattered. Friends like you are not found every day — and I never want to take that for granted.

On your birthday, my wish for you is simple and huge at the same time: may this year give you back even a fraction of the happiness you give to everyone around you. May your dreams get closer, your worries get smaller, and your smile — that famous Kiran smile — never fade.

Keep shining in your sarees, keep posing like the main character (because you are), and keep being exactly who you are. The world is better with you in it, and my life definitely is.

Here's to you, today and always. Happy birthday, bestie. 🎂💖

— YOUR BEST FRIEND,
Rabindra
Made with love, for the best best friend Happy Birthday, Kiran 🎂 · From Rabindra, with all my heart
